comment: DVB-S2 service information: the sections of dvbs2/sections on the PSI/SI PIDs (0x00-0x1F:
PAT, CAT, NIT, SDT/BAT, EIT, RST, TDT/TOT, ST) and on `pids` (the PMTs the PAT names), each read by
header/link/dvb_si: a message a section, its table by `table_id.name` (the network and its delivery systems, the
services, the events, the UTC time and local offsets), its CRC-32 checked (the TDT has none).
The transport packets are captured for Wireshark, which reads the tables itself

pids.comment: more PIDs to read sections of: the PMTs' (the PAT's programs)

sections.active: afc & 1 and (pid <= 31 or pid in more)
